description: Grid mode performance: 1M points × 4 panels; measures JS heap size and per-frame render time.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1_000_000
df = pd.DataFrame(rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['cat'] = (rng.integers(0, 5, n)).astype(str)
df['val'] = rng.normal(0, 1, n)

steps.name: wait for ready (1M rows)
steps.report: { nRows: a.describe && a.describe.nRows, nAnchors: a.describe && a.describe.nAnchors }

steps.name: baseline heap and frame time (single view, all rows placed)
steps.eval: a.setColorColumn(a.describe.columns.find(c=>c.name==='cat').index); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const t0=performance.now(); let frames=0; await new Promise(resolve=>{ function step(){ frames++; if(performance.now()-t0<1000) requestAnimationFrame(step); else resolve(); } requestAnimationFrame(step); }); window.__baselineMs = (performance.now()-t0)/frames; window.__baselineHeap = performance.memory ? performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize : -1

steps.name: grid heap and frame time (4 panels)
steps.eval: await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r)); const t0=performance.now(); let frames=0; await new Promise(resolve=>{ function step(){ frames++; if(performance.now()-t0<1000) requestAnimationFrame(step); else resolve(); } requestAnimationFrame(step); }); window.__gridMs = (performance.now()-t0)/frames; window.__gridHeap = performance.memory ? performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize : -1
